kn5000-3c7: 2026-10-31 (lane open4/kn5000-b-cpanel): analog controllers identified and renamed in v10/v9/v7/v6/v5 (scripts/renaming/rename_open4_cpanel.sed, 108 rules). From the service manual (CPL sheet II-35: AD1 BEND, AD2 MOD, AD3 MAIN VOLUME VR1, AD0 grounded; CPU sheet II-11: AN0 EXP pedal, AN1 AFT after-touch) and the firmware's panel-record tags (0xB1 pitch bend, 0xB2 modulation, 0xB0+1 TOTAL EXPRESSION / 0xB3 part expression, 0xB4 channel pressure): id 25 = pitch bend (Encoder_ProcessPitchBend, 14-bit split, centre dead band, bend-range rescale while recording), 26 = modulation (Encoder_ProcessModulation), 27 = MAIN VOLUME (Encoder_ProcessMainVolume, record 0xB0 +0, inferred), 2 = expression pedal on CPU AN0 (Encoder_ProcessExpressionPedal, FOOT CONTROLLERS assignment 182/183), 5 = after touch on CPU AN1 (Encoder_ProcessAfterTouch, threshold + curve from record 0x93). The old breath/foot/volume-slider/modwheel names were wrong. Evidence, rename table and the website draft (control-panel-protocol.md sections 3, 5, 6; hardware-architecture.md) in notes/open4-kn5000-b/cpanel/README.md. Caveats: id = 24 + AD channel and record 0xB0 byte 0 = master volume are inferences (panel MCU ROM undumped). Outcome: repo work CLOSED; leave open until the docs lane publishes the draft.
kn5000-bq4: 2026-10-31 (lane open4/kn5000-b-cpanel): CPanel_InitLEDBuffer renamed CPanel_SendFramePolled -- it sends WA as one 2-byte SC1 frame with polled timing and has no caller (no source reference, no address copy in the v10/v7 ROMs, probes/ref_scan.py). Power-on LED pattern: no lamp test and no all-off command from the main CPU; CPanel_LED_FlushImage (was CtrlPanel_UpdateLEDState) sends only rows whose CPANEL_LED_IMAGE differs from CPANEL_LED_IMAGE_SENT, both zeroed by Boot_InitWorkRAM. Measured in MAME (probes/led_boot_tap.lua + logs): at ~7.75 s emulated STANDARD ROCK, VARIATION 1, DIGITAL REVERB, PIANO, PART RIGHT 1 + CONDUCTOR RIGHT 1; SUSTAIN at 7.92 s; OTHER PARTS/TR at 12.87 s. LED queue pushers renamed CPanel_LedQueue_PushByte/PushBlock (were Seq_TimerEventLoop / SeqBuf_TimerEvent_BytecodeBlock2). Website draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/cpanel/README.md, 'kn5000-bq4' and 'Website page drafts' (control-panel-protocol.md new 'Power-on LED sequence' subsection, section 7 row fix). Caveat: MAME times, BAD_DUMP sub-CPU boot ROM; what the panel MCUs show before the first frame depends on their undumped ROMs. Outcome: repo work CLOSED; leave open until the draft is published.
kn5000-9ye: 2026-10-31 (lane open4/kn5000-b-cpanel): frame types 6/7 decoded from CPanel_RX_MultiBytePacket / CPanel_SM_RXByte1: H0 bits 7:6 panel, 5:4 = 11, 3:0 = N-1 (N = 1..16; type 7 is just a run longer than 8), H1 bits 4:0 = first segment (bit 4 clear) or controller id (bit 4 set), then N state bytes -> one record per byte. CPANEL_TX_RX_FLAGS bit 4 is never set (the unchanged-segment drop is dead code); CPANEL_PROTOCOL_FLAGS: only bit 0 (RX ring full) is read, bits 1/3/6/7 are write-only, bit 2 is written only by unreachable code after CPanel_SM_Idle (probes/flag_access_scan.py, probes/ref_scan.py). Headers added in all five trees. Website draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/cpanel/README.md 'kn5000-9ye' and 'Website page drafts' (section 6 flag tables, section 9 resolved). The remaining child kn5000-qhm is BLOCKED on MAME (HLE implementation), not on this repo. Outcome: repo work CLOSED; leave open until the draft is published.
kn5000-xhi: 2026-10-31 (lane open4/kn5000-b-cpanel): read from service manual sheet II-35 (PDF page 45): one encoder, SW101 TEMPO/PROGRAM; pin A to ground; B and C each pulled up by 4.7 kOhm (R11/R12) and fed through 47 kOhm (R13/R14) to IC1 M37471M2196S pins 30 ROTA / 31 ROTB with 0.001 uF (C7/C8) to ground: RC low-pass, tau = 47 us. The MCU decodes the quadrature and sends [0xD7, count]. Also read: AD0 grounded, AD1 BEND, AD2 MOD, AD3 MAIN VOLUME (VR1 20 kOhm B), 4 MHz crystal, serial pins.
